title: Actor step
description: The actor agent's entire turn: one thought, one action, one expectation. schema_version 7.
$comment: The canonical VALIDATION contract — the real gate, compiled per driver by forcedToolCall. `action` is a FLAT object: one `type` verb plus the flat parameters that verb uses (NOT a oneOf union). Per-verb required parameters are enforced by the `allOf` if/then block. drivers/overlay.ts projects this per driver: stepSchemaFor() scopes the `type` (and `direction`) enum to a driver's verbs and is what validates; toolParamsFor() derives a stripped, model-facing copy (no allOf/additionalProperties/min-max, only the driver's fields). The OpenAI-compat endpoint does NOT constrain decoding, so the shipped schema is documentation and THIS file is enforcement. Verbs — web: click/type/select/scroll/navigate/back/wait/done/give_up; mobile: tap/type/swipe/scroll/back/wait/done/give_up; api: request/wait/done/give_up (wait, done, give_up shared across all drivers; back is web+mobile). schema_version 7 adds optional `raises` (structured confusion/finding sticky notes, multiple per turn); `confused`/`confused_reason` remain as sugar for a single confusion raise.

thought.description: Your reasoning, read later in the viewer and kept in the running log: what you see that matters, the action you want and why, and any uncertainty. Format it with newlines into short lines or short paragraphs — coherent and readable, never one dense unbroken block.

expectation.description: Free-form prediction of what should happen after the action executes.

visual.description: Only when a screenshot was provided: your visual read of the rendered page — what drew the eye first, what competed for attention, and what was missed or hard to find. Omit on text-only turns.

raises.description: Optional structured sticky notes for this turn — not narrative thought. Use when you would tell a colleague "look at this" or "I'm stuck". Multiple entries allowed (e.g. one finding and one confusion). Omit the whole field when there is nothing to raise. Does not stop the run.

kind.description: confusion = you are stuck / cannot progress / page makes no sense for the goal. finding = you noticed something about the product (broken, misleading, hard to find, surprising) worth reviewing later.

note.description: One or two quotable lines: what you saw and why it matters. Prefer quotes from the page over vague complaint.

severity.description: Optional weight: info (nudge), minor (friction), major (blocks or clearly wrong). Omit when unsure.

confused.description: Legacy sugar for a single confusion raise. Prefer `raises: [{ kind: "confusion", note: "…" }]`. Set true ONLY when stuck this turn; when true, give confused_reason. Leave out when fine. Does not stop the run.

confused_reason.description: One line on WHY you are confused or stuck (only when confused is true). Prefer the `raises` array when you have more than one note.

axe.description: web only: axe-core WCAG 2.0 A/AA + 2.1 AA violations (always-on for web, never enters the actor prompt). A single full-page `axe.run` over the whole document, counting every violation on the page. On executed agent/act steps it is captured best-effort after the following snapshot; model-driven scans run during the following model turn, while act replay joins before its next dispatch. Dynamic page timers may change the scanned state in that measured deferral window. On terminal done/give_up steps it is captured inline from the page the actor ended on. Absent on non-web runs, state-drift markers, and when axe capture fails.

violations.description: Up to 25 violations. Each is one axe rule firing on one or more page nodes.

help.description: One-line remediation guidance from axe (how to fix), capped at 300 chars. Optional — older captures omit it.

help_url.description: Canonical Deque docs URL for the rule (axe helpUrl, version-pinned). Optional — the viewer constructs a fallback link from the rule id when absent.

wcag_tags.description: WCAG success-criterion tags carried by the rule, e.g. ["wcag2a","wcag111"].

target.description: CSS selector path to the offending node.

html.description: The node's outer HTML, capped at 200 chars.

total.description: Total violation NODE count for this step (sum of nodes across all violations, full-page run).

type.description: The single verb to perform this turn.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e42" (click/type/select/tap; optional for scroll/swipe).

text.description: Text to type into the element; replaces the current value (type).

value.description: Visible label or value of the option to select (select).

url.description: Absolute URL or path relative to base_url (navigate).

seconds.description: How long to wait, in seconds (wait).

path.description: Request path or URL relative to base_url (request).

body.description: Optional request body — a JSON value for application/json, or a string (request).

summary.description: What was accomplished, in the persona's voice (done).

reason.description: Why the task cannot be completed (give_up).
